url.description: URL is the cache service base URL. Empty disables the feature.

token.description: Token is the org-scoped service token, inline. Prefer TokenFile or the environment for production credentials.

tokenFile.description: TokenFile is a path the token is read from at boot.

scope.description: Scope is the cache namespace within the org (by convention the repository identity for CI fleets).

importBudget.description: ImportBudget bounds the whole boot-time bundle inflow (selection, downloads, merges). Exhaustion degrades to fewer bundles, then none — never a boot failure. Default 1m.

importLimit.description: ImportLimit is the maximum number of bundles requested at boot. Zero means the service default.

exportOnShutdown.description: ExportOnShutdown opts into a budget-bounded cache export during graceful shutdown (after sessions drain and prune runs).

exportBudget.description: ExportBudget bounds a shutdown export so shutdown cannot hang; an exhausted budget costs blobs, never correctness. Default 2m. Exports triggered through the admin API are bounded by their caller instead.

metadataOnly.description: MetadataOnly makes exports skip content chains and blob upload: importers get lookup warmth and recompute content via lazy forms.

exportSecret.description: ExportSecret optionally guards the engine's export admin endpoint: when set, POST /v1/cache/export requires it in the X-Dagger-Export-Secret header (defense in depth on the operator listener).

CacheServiceConfig.description: CacheServiceConfig wires the engine to a remote cache service.

logLevel.description: LogLevel defines the engine's logging level.

gc.description: GC configures the engine's garbage collector.

security.description: Security allows configuring various security settings for the engine.

registries.description: Registries configures custom registry mirrors, root CAs, and insecure/HTTP access.

cacheService.description: CacheService configures the remote cache service integration: bundle import at boot, content-chain blob fetch at serving time, and cache export. Absent (and with no DAGGER_CACHE_SERVICE_* environment overrides) the whole feature is disabled.

DiskSpace.description: DiskSpace is either an integer number of bytes (e.g. 512000000), a string with a byte unit suffix (e.g. "512MB"), or a string percentage of the total disk space (e.g. "10%").

Duration.description: Duration is either an integer number of seconds (e.g. 3600), or a string representation of the time (e.g. "1h30m").

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether the garbage collector is enabled - it is switched on by default (and generally shouldn't be turned off, except for very short-lived dagger instances).

reservedSpace.description: ReservedSpace is the minimum amount of disk space this policy is guaranteed to retain. Any usage below this threshold will not be reclaimed during garbage collection.

maxUsedSpace.description: MaxUsedSpace is the maximum amount of disk space this policy is allowed to use. Any usage exceeding this limit will be cleaned up during a garbage collection sweep.

minFreeSpace.description: MinFreeSpace is the target amount of free disk space the garbage collector will attempt to leave. However, it will never let the available space fall below ReservedSpace.

sweepSize.description: SweepSize is the minimum amount of space to sweep during a single gc pass. Either an absolute number of bytes, or a percentage of the "allowed space" between reserved and max.

policies.description: Policies are a list of manually configured policies - if not specified, an automatic default will be generated from the top-level disk space parameters.

filters.description: Filters are a list of containerd filters to match specific cache records. The available filters are: "id", "parents", "description", "inuse", "mutable", "immutable", "type", "shared", and "private".

keepDuration.description: KeepDuration specifies the minimum amount of time to keep records in this policy.

reservedSpace.description: ReservedSpace is the minimum amount of disk space this policy is guaranteed to retain. Any usage below this threshold will not be reclaimed during garbage collection.

maxUsedSpace.description: MaxUsedSpace is the maximum amount of disk space this policy is allowed to use. Any usage exceeding this limit will be cleaned up during a garbage collection sweep.

minFreeSpace.description: MinFreeSpace is the target amount of free disk space the garbage collector will attempt to leave. However, it will never let the available space fall below ReservedSpace.

sweepSize.description: SweepSize is the minimum amount of space to sweep during a single gc pass. Either an absolute number of bytes, or a percentage of the "allowed space" between reserved and max.

insecureRootCapabilities.description: InsecureRootCapabilities controls whether the argument of the same name is permitted in Container.withExec - it is allowed by default. Disabling this option ensures that dagger build containers do not run as privileged, and is a basic form of security hardening.
